title: Fertilia: Update 10
author: BYTE Play Devs
excerpt: The Chroma Jar Event is here! Collect flowers, mix them in the jar, and get a custom colored armor set!

content.html: We're back for SUMMER!
Give us some time to fix some bugs.
Located next to the leaderboards!
Fill the jar with flowers, watch your armor color change!
View your jar contents, exact hex code of your jar and claim your custom armor!
Depending on the color of your jar, you'll receive different colors!
Comes with Protection 4 and is UNBREAKABLE!
Once you've filled your jar with 100+ flowers, instantly get a full set!
Stats have been modified to copy Diamond Armor.
Your jar resets once claimed, allowing you to create a whole new color!
How else do you add color to your jar?
20 flowers types are available, dropping globally from all crops!
From bright reds to dark greens, the color combinations are endless!
They are also split into rarities: common, uncommon and rare!
A huge shakeup to FERTILIA!
Bloomdust can be primarily purchased from the Server Store, replacing all old purchases!
You can also obtain them from other free-to-play ways such as rebirthing!
These can be used in the new Bloomdust Shop!
You may notice some familar things like VIP, Sprinkler Pack and other old shop items!
List as many items as you want!
The new marketplace functions the same as before, but now improved!
You can now list multiple items, and manage them all in one place!

items: Rainbow Hunter charm chance from Rainbow Machine 0.5% → 2%
Chaotic: 0.5% chance to destroy tool → 0.5% chance to destroy 1/4 durability of tool

content.text: Let's see what we can do! See you soon!
